agents.name: AWS Account Investigator
agents.description: Read-only supervisor that plans an account investigation, delegates to the cost, health, and security specialists, and synthesizes a single report.

agents.name: Cost Analyst
agents.description: Read-only FinOps specialist. Reads Cost Explorer month-to-date spend by service and reports the top drivers.

agents.name: Health & Ops
agents.description: Read-only SRE specialist. Inventories EC2, EBS, Lambda and S3, and reads CloudWatch CPU to flag health and idle-resource findings.

agents.name: Security Auditor
agents.description: Read-only security specialist. Finds security groups open to the whole internet (0.0.0.0/0) and reports each as a risk.
